· 稀有宝箱掉落的防御塔，会以【可交易版】发放 —— 你可以在 Steam 社区市场自由出售它们。
· 未购买的玩家掉落率与玩法完全一致；只是物品为账号绑定版，只能收藏、不能出售。

掉落说明：游戏内每在线满 1 小时触发一次稀有宝箱掉落，由服务器判定并发放，与是否购买本 DLC 无关。
一次购买，永久有效，适用于该 Steam 账号下的所有存档。

（本 DLC 不改变任何掉落概率、不影响游戏平衡，仅决定掉落物品是否可在社区市场流通。）

apps.name: [NEOLITHIC] GER Editor
apps.short_description: [NEOLITHIC]To the End's current generation development editor. (Still, it can open and edit any RPG Maker XP projects anyway.)

apps.name: 30 Days
apps.short_description: 「30 Days」 will change someone's life, maybe your life.

apps.name: 99 Legit Manager
apps.short_description: 99 Legit Manager is a fantasy football management game. Sign orcs, elves, robots, zombies, and giants, manage your club's finances to claim league and cup glory. The game features match betting and behind-the-scenes schemes—match-fixing, bribery, and stock market manipulation.

apps.name: A Red Specter Haunts the World
apps.short_description: Build a highly organized Communist Party with iron discipline; seize power through armed struggle; liberate all oppressed people; and march toward the fulfillment and realization of the Party’s highest goals and ultimate ideals

apps.name: A Waddle Quest
apps.short_description: A cozy but chaotic adventure in a world where magic shouldn’t exist. Play as a very determined waddler (not necessarily qualified, but definitely available) sent to figure it out, explore strange lands, fight magical creatures, collect gear, and bring a friend in local co-op for extra chaos and fun.

apps.name: Age of Transport
apps.short_description: Classification yards, waybills and live dispatch — on a 1:4-scale Earth. Build a multi-modal freight empire across rail, sea and air through twelve eras of transport history, in a persistent world shared by up to 255 companies.

apps.name: AI Dungeon
apps.short_description: An AI-powered text-based RPG like you've never played before. Write stories, interact with realistic characters, and experience virtually infinite worlds and genres. Escape to alternate universes where you direct the action and anything is possible!

apps.name: ANONYMIZED
apps.short_description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

apps.name: APEX Trading Life
apps.short_description: An endless multi-asset trading simulator. Start with $500 and a job you hate. Trade crypto, stocks, leveraged forex and property, cover the rent every week, climb five broker tiers to earn shorting and margin, and decide when you can afford to walk out of the day job for good.

apps.name: Astonia Forever
apps.short_description: Astonia Forever is a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore towns and dangerous dungeons, complete quests, develop your skills and spells, collect powerful equipment, trade with other players, and join clans in a persistent online world.

apps.name: Avarice: Hotel
apps.short_description: Avarice: Hotel is a 3D first person horror/thriller set in an eerie 1800s hotel. The higher you climb, the further you fall. Navigate a descent into madness as greed turns luxury and power into a living nightmare.

apps.name: AvarothOnline
apps.short_description: Avaroth Online is an open-world MMORPG with PvP combat, character progression, and exploration across lands inspired by Argentina. Gather resources, build, and face enemies and players alike in a hostile, persistent world.

apps.name: Azimuth
apps.short_description: Construct colossal megastructures in this industrial, retro-futuristic idle game. Manage grid-based modules, explore exotic star systems, and unlock the secrets of reality through exploitation and optimization.

apps.name: Babushka
apps.short_description: A Cozy Roguelite set in a mystical Slavic forest starring Vesna, a quest-completing babushka that thrashes mutated creatures and malicious forest spirits in Turn-Based Combat. An exciting genre mix of Farming simulation, Roguelite, and Narrative.

apps.name: Baby Snow
apps.short_description: Take on the role of the courageous Baby Snow as he battles with the tiger's who have attacked his home and captured the Lady Penelope.

apps.name: Balance Of Death
apps.short_description: Command soldiers, hunt as a vampire, or transform into a werewolf in a dark fantasy multiplayer survival horror RPG. Build NPC relationships and shape the world's lore for future players. Death ends your character's life, but your deeds can remain!

apps.name: Bato Battle
apps.short_description: Bato Battle is a chaotic submarine party combat game for 2-8 players. Pilot a whale, ram a shark, dive like a dolphin, and torpedo your friends across a pile of ridiculous gamemodes and maps!

apps.name: Battle For Abraham VR
apps.short_description: Battle For Abraham VR is a single player open world VR shooter. The player will choose missions to clear forests and villages of enemy soldiers using one rifle with a limited amount of ammunition. To reach enemy positions, you must avoid or destroy drones, tanks, and other heavy weaponry.

apps.name: Beast & Bloom: Tower Defense
apps.short_description: Beast & Bloom blends maze-building tower defense, random recruitment, and three-way fusion. Recruit adorable guardians, shape enemy paths, and fuse powerful allies. Use magical items to turn obstacles into guardians and grant anti-air powers. Defend your forest against ground and flying foes!

apps.name: Before All Saints Day
apps.short_description: One night. One secret. One very curious ghost. Step into a 10–20 minute atmospheric Halloween tale where a human girl hides among ghosts at their yearly festival — and tries to slip away before a mischievous boy exposes what she really is.

apps.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase
apps.short_description:
《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》 is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners.
An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.

apps.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
apps.short_description: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

apps.name: Booster Pack Heroes
apps.short_description: Rip open booster packs and pull your next foil hero in Booster Pack Heroes - an incremental game where every pack could contain your next powerhouse. Defend the tower from an endless onslaught of monsters and fight your way through the realms.

apps.name: Breaking Weather
apps.short_description: Play as the seeker with weather controlling power to destroy the environment and find the hiders! Or play as the hider and ensure that you are able to stay alive and finish the missions before you are caught by the weather!

apps.name: BrideOfDawn
apps.short_description: Three women appear before the last heir of a shaman family, each saying the same thing: marry me, or you won't live. One is the true bride. One came to kill you. Over the 49 days before the final rite, every bond you build is a wager on your life — an occult romance mystery visual novel.

apps.name: Caelovista
apps.short_description: A science-based 3D universe explorer spanning scales from quarks to the observable universe.

apps.name: Call of Hegalia
apps.short_description: The mystery of the disappearance of Sadie and John Smith is yours to uncover. Talk to the towns folk, play minigames to reveal further details, and explore the forest to put together the pieces. In small towns, everyone has an opinion.

apps.name: Camel Keeper
apps.short_description: Embark on a delightful desert adventure in Camel Keeper, a charming Tamagotchi-inspired simulation where you become the ultimate camel caretaker! 🐪💕

apps.name: Campfire Simulator
apps.short_description: Build, light and tend a realistic campfire. Chop wood, brew tea, toast marshmallows and play guitar under the stars.

apps.name: Can You Beat The AI God?
apps.short_description: Can You Beat The AI God? is an action-packed bullet-heaven roguelite. Survive endless swarms of robotic enemies, unlock devastating synergies, and upgrade your abilities. Test your limits and see if you can defeat the ultimate AI God!

apps.name: Carbonara Crew
apps.short_description: A first-person cooking sim where you run a tiny Italian restaurant, solo or with friends. Cook every dish right, serve your customers, wash the dishes: the whole restaurant is in your hands. Literally.

apps.name: Cascade
apps.short_description: Paint spells. Break the cascade. Build four hand-crafted spells, survive an escalating action roguelite campaign, then push its Rift Depth 1-99 endgame.

apps.name: Castle: Build & Defend
apps.short_description:
Build by day. Hold until dawn. 
Build and fortify a medieval village in a castle builder with resource management and wave defense. Every minute counts.

apps.name: CD2: Trap Master - Prologue
apps.short_description: Become THE Trap Master - play your deck of lethal traps to mow down waves of bizarre creatures and protect your altars! Craft a unique deck of traps and powers, discover treasure of surprise effects, and guard a different base each time until you are ready for the unforgiving boss.

apps.name: CGC - Cemetery
apps.short_description: Crisis Guard Corporation (CGC) is hiring. Five-night security contract. No prior experience required. Competitive compensation. Positions available immediately.

apps.name: Chaosoccer
apps.short_description: Chaosoccer is a fun, physics-based multiplayer soccer party game. Spend a whole afternoon having fun with friends!

apps.name: Cherry Clouds * Scarlet Love
apps.short_description: Tsukasa Kazami, a young man from the year 2020, is suddenly transported 100 years into the past and finds himself wrapped up in the investigations of the strange British detective known as the Chief. Will his fate lead him back to the present, or will he remain trapped in the past?

apps.name: Circuit Depot - Retro Computer Shop Simulator
apps.short_description: Run a small-town computer shop in 1999. Buy broken PCs for a few dollars, open them up, find the fault and repair them, build custom machines for customers, stock the shelves and grow the store. Then close up shop and play the games on the computers you saved.

apps.name: Clash of Melodies
apps.short_description:
A Visual Novel Rhythm Game that tells the story of two dorks who don't like each other going on an adventure together.
Play the DDR / FNF inspired Arrow Mode and the original Circle Mode.
Enjoy the story or go for a highscore in Freeplay.

apps.name: Clayton & Cayo
apps.short_description: Journey up to the summit of Starfall Peak with your best friend Cayo, reminiscing on the past—and bonding along the way—in this emotional adventure game about friendship. And only friendship.

apps.name: Clearance Defence
apps.short_description: Defend the clearance shelf. When the lights go out, the seasonal war begins. Lead your unsold Easter stock against waves of full-price enemies — before morning reveals the secret.

apps.name: Clicker, Clicks Something
apps.short_description: An idle clicker about one very busy cursor. Click trees and rocks, build huts, put your villagers to work, buy and explore island after island and help the locals, while monsters and their creeping corruption try to take it all back.

apps.name: Clock-Out Crew
apps.short_description: An idle RPG that lives on your taskbar. A crew of 24 office-meme heroes fights the bosses of office life while you work, gets stronger on your real schedule, and throws a parade the moment you clock out. Bonuses only. No penalties, no data collected.

apps.name: CloudForth
apps.short_description: Four floating islands once thrived with oxygen, but monsters corrupted the air. Dr. ??? created “SatatiRoid,” a mochi-like android that must gather oxygen while battling O2 Clan bosses. Collect “Cloud Caches” to confront the true mastermind and restore the world’s oxygen.

apps.name: Concorrenza
apps.short_description: An offensively inaccurate depiction of the competition between Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo Buonarroti told with cartoonish sensibilities. | Ah! To be "vuomo eccellentissimo e singhularissimo"...

apps.name: Concrete Polishing Simulator
apps.short_description: Turn rough concrete into polished floors in a hands-on first-person simulator developed by a real concrete polisher. Operate professional equipment, complete every stage from preparation to sealing, and build your reputation one job at a time.

apps.name: Confess To Me
apps.short_description: Confess to Me is a dark, kinetic novella rated 18+ about power, psychological pressure, and dangerous attraction.

apps.name: Console Companions
apps.short_description:
Accessorize your desktop experience with customizable retro consoles on your screen.
Draw, decorate, write, and even keep track of time. With a focus on functionality and long term support, Console Companions will continue to grow with its community!
Linux compatible on most distros.

apps.name: Cooking Fist
apps.short_description: Cooking Fist is a cooking-fighting game with NO health bars. You’ll have to cook up the best dishes to claim victory. Fight with a diverse roster of chefs, each with their own fighting and culinary styles. Challenge your friends locally or online with Rollback netcode!

apps.name: Core Reset
apps.short_description: Are you a capable mech test pilot. Can you clear the challenges the test plan lays out for you. The test plans get harder, the further you push. Core Reset is a fast paced, rogue-lite, bullet heaven that pushes your limits.

apps.name: Cozy Necromancy
apps.short_description: A gentle mystery about a village that cannot let go of its dead. As a journeyman necromancer, you lay six spirits to rest by listening to them, investigating what holds them, and making your case with three objects in a ritual circle. No combat, no timers, no fail states.

apps.name: Cyber Mission II
apps.short_description: Return to the fight for the galaxy's future as a cyber trooper in a mix of shoot ’em up and run ’n gun action! Cyber Mission II is a side-scrolling shoot ’em up with retro aesthetics, dynamic combat, HD visuals and intense combat inspired by classic elements from both run ’n gun and shooter genres.

apps.name: Darn Guy Adventures
apps.short_description: Darn Guy Adventures is an RPG adventure following the titular Kishan "Darn Guy", Tinta and Norton as they are sent into a mission they are utterly underqualified for. Encounter verbose bushes, mathematical rocks and very loud wolfmen on the quest to save a town with an expiration date.

apps.name: Dead Man's Crown
apps.short_description: One night. A court of liars. One final accusation. Dead Man’s Crown is a gothic social deduction game of secret roles, shifting identities, and dangerous alliances. Uncover what happened during the night, convince the council, and cast your vote—but your own allegiance may have changed.

apps.name: Dig! Dig! Dig for Treasure
apps.short_description: A 2D puzzle adventure game with hand drawn style. In the night map, you only need to press the C key on the keyboard to excavate hidden treasures on the ground, crack the mechanisms in the correct order, take a boat to reach Mist Island, and complete the exploration of five levels of night fog.

apps.name: Digger
apps.short_description:
You are mining robots sent into an abandoned mine. Your mission: extract as much ore as possible and bring it back to base before midnight.
Your face, your voice
Your webcam is displayed on your robot's screen, and voice chat is spatial.

apps.name: Dinky Delvers
apps.short_description: Multiplayer 2D pixel-art dungeon crawler. Classic Tank, Healer, DPS party system; dungeon-and-delve without the MMO grind!

apps.name: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
apps.short_description:
An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players!

Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system!

Friendship or betrayal? Money or power?
Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

apps.name: DreadMist
apps.short_description: DreadMist is a seamless open-world fantasy sandbox simulation. A deep mechanical sandbox where you can begin as a lowly beggar, recruit more characters, master crafting, trading, fighting, and buy property to create your own place in the world.

apps.name: Drift Wars
apps.short_description:
A new style of RTS that focuses heavily on terraforming and changing terrain to different types to overcome your opponent !

Inspired by old-school RTSes but with next-generation RTS ideas !

apps.name: Drone Arena
apps.short_description: A survivors-like arena roguelite. Pilot a drone, stack weapons and upgrades into absurd builds, and hold out against waves of mechas until the timer runs out. Every run ends. Every run teaches.

apps.name: Dunar: Dimension Two
apps.short_description: A traditional turn-based JRPG featuring unique moments and a fascinating story centered around the forgotten past of the Purple Light, blending fantasy with inspirations from Himba culture and Indian aesthetics.

apps.name: Eat You way out
apps.short_description: Eat your way through a Mediterranean holiday property buried in living green jelly. Carve paths with a spoon, manage your stomach, deposit what you swallow, upgrade strange tools, uncover shortcuts, and escape before the mass reveals its secret.

apps.name: ecoSYSTEMS
apps.short_description: Shape a living planet, study its shifting seasons, and build a resilient society across a world defined by climate, resources, and risk. Every civilization begins with understanding the world beneath it. Make thoughtful compromises and build a world that can withstand the scope of human impact.

apps.name: Eichmark
apps.short_description: Eichmark is a dark medieval strategy RPG. Walk a war-torn land of bandits, castles and intrigue, raise your army and lead it in real-time regiment battles with walls, gates and ladders. Your choices shape the story and those who fall stay fallen.

apps.name: Exitus
apps.short_description: You have found the job you were looking for. Your only concern is your quota. or else? Protein was always the problem. The HFU solved it. Keep your head down, Do your job, you are here for a reason. Exitus is a terminal-style decision game. Pull up each case, then decide their fate.

apps.name: Fantasy For You
apps.short_description:
The classic fantasy MMORPG Fantasy For You (판타지포유/F4U/Fantasy4U/英雄) returns. 
Launched in Korea in 1999, expanded to Taiwan. Build your hero across 3 races and 20 bloodlines, face unpredictable combat with random skills. No healing potions — a hydration system and the field-dominating Barak War.

apps.name: Feed The Vessel
apps.short_description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

apps.name: Four Lights, One Thief: A Shadow Puzzle
apps.short_description: Switch between four light sources to turn shadows into pathways in this stealth puzzle game. Use crates, shutters, and mirrors to outwit guards and cameras. Solve 180 stages across Normal and Hard modes, then challenge cleared stages in Survival mode.

apps.name: FreshWomen - Season 3
apps.short_description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focused on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just won a mansion. Bring girls to your home to date, hang out with or have sex with them. Your journey will be full of comedy, love and lots of sex.

apps.name: Ghostie Town
apps.short_description: Welcome to Ghostie Town, a cozy game about restoring a forgotten town. You’re a small ghost on a big mission: fix fences, water plants, sweep streets, and help ghostie residents settle in as the town comes back to life. A heartwarming, story-rich, repair game.

apps.name: Giant Girls Rampage
apps.short_description: Giant Girls Rampage is an idle clicker where you battle titanic monster girls threatening your land. Deal damage, farm coins, upgrade town infrastructure, and recruit allied fighters.

apps.name: Gold Idle
apps.short_description: Start with a single coin. Flip, upgrade, and automate your way to a fortune in an incremental game where progress uncovers more than bigger numbers. Push past familiar limits and discover things you were never meant to find.

apps.name: Goldfall
apps.short_description: Goldfall is a persistent medieval sandbox survival MMORPG. Hunt, gather, craft, build, trade and fight to survive. Raise animals, own property, master professions and join a player-driven world of families, politics, religion and power.

apps.name: Golf 5 MAX
apps.short_description: Launching November 2 on Steam! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust, where every hole is all or nothing. Play solo or challenge rivals worldwide. Try the free demo now!

apps.name: Good Boy Good Girl
apps.short_description: Train your loyal dog to fetch balls and frisbees across challenging parks, but watch out for wild dogs trying to disrupt your fun! Clear every park to reach the ultimate finale at the sunny beach.

apps.name: Gopher It: Office Intern Simulator
apps.short_description: Gopher It is a cozy first-person job sim about being the newest intern in an office full of animals. When someone calls, you go and do what they want: copies, coffee, the post, a birthday card to pass round. Play solo or with up to three friends. No timers, no game over.

apps.name: GrassCutting
apps.short_description:
Take a breather after an intense gaming session. 
Choose your mowing tool, roam varied terrain, and clear wild plants in satisfying swaths. 
Upgrade, collect Golden Grass, use a time-stop ability, and try different weapons on a fresh, randomly generated map each run—all at your own pace.

apps.name: Guild of Souls
apps.short_description: Build a guild of heroes and play them all, inspired by classic MMOs. Swap between your own characters mid-fight, fill dungeons and 40-hero raids with them, and master 40 classes in tab-target combat. 24 professions, an auction house and a Chaosborn roguelike endgame class. Solo or 1-5 player co-op.

apps.name: Gun Monkey!
apps.short_description: Help your monkey escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

apps.name: HackMeNow
apps.short_description: A terminal-style hacking puzzle game where every command matters. Investigate logs, decode secrets, avoid traps, and uncover the rogue system watching from behind the screen.

apps.name: Harbor
apps.short_description: Harbor is a first-person PvP survival game in a post-apocalyptic wasteland. Scavenge, craft and build a base you can upgrade and defend. Team up, raid other players and chase down the War Truck and Blackrail train. Harbor is the only safe zone. Die out there and you can lose everything you carry.

apps.name: Hatsune Miku Connecting Puzzle TAMAGOTORI Deluxe
apps.short_description:
Connect eggs with simple controls!
Join Miku and friends to collect cute illustrations and a flock of birds!

apps.name: HEADSHOT: Zombie Doomsday
apps.short_description: Aim for the head as zombies close in through darkness and fear. Earn gold, unlock permanent upgrades, and survive escalating waves of special infected and bosses in this 2D pixel survival shooter. Choose upgrades carefully, control the horde, and push for a higher score in every short run.

apps.name: Hexborn
apps.short_description: A blood-fueled roguelite FPS inspired by Doom and Vampire Survivors — but instead of one arena, fight solo or with a friend through cursed labyrinths that reshape every run. Draft brutal perks, wield occult firepower, and survive escalating horrors with a retro shooter soul.

apps.name: Hollow Tithes
apps.short_description: Lead four heroes into shifting dungeons in this dark fantasy, turn-based RPG. Build your party, battle deadly foes, uncover secrets, and claim rare loot. Defeat each dungeon’s boss to escape with your spoils, restore your town, and prepare for the next descent.

apps.name: Hotel Investigation 09
apps.short_description: An archival of a strange game that cropped up online. Play as Howlz, explore the hotel's halls, and rescue the captive under the building.

apps.name: Immune Response
apps.short_description: An exciting twin-stick shooter with a progressively increasing difficulty. Fight waves of pathogenic enemies, face difficult boss fights and survive for as long as you can!

apps.name: Infected Hotline
apps.short_description:
A job-sim adventure set in a dystopian multiverse, where cards are knowledge.
Learn your job and its secrets to survive the weekend at Mr. Pepperoni's Pizzeria. 
That's it. Nothing weird going on here, I swear. Keep scrollin'

apps.name: JANYANG
apps.short_description: A 1v1 card battle over three locations, fought with cards inhabited by yokai. When a round ends, the side with more attack power at a location takes it. Your character attacks directly, too, and you build a deck of exactly 30 cards.

apps.name: Jeweler Simulator
apps.short_description: Jeweler Simulator: Become the King of Precious Stones! Equip your store with the most dazzling diamonds and put them up for sale to acquire even better ones. Rise in the leaderboard with the prestige you'll gain and become one of the world's top jewelers.

apps.name: Jeweler Simulator: Prologue
apps.short_description: Jeweler Simulator: Prologue Become the King of Precious Stones! Equip your store with the most dazzling diamonds and put them up for sale to acquire even better ones. Rise in the leaderboard with the prestige you'll gain and become one of the world's top jewelers!

apps.name: Kagari of Hinoko Town
apps.short_description: Gather materials to forge weapons, and craft items when you need them. Master diverse weapon types, Gear Actions, and Gear Bursts in a turn-based roguelike RPG. Venture ever deeper on a journey of exploration and crafting.

apps.name: Kill Or Be Killed
apps.short_description: Kill Or Be Killed is a fast-paced action combat game where deadly combos and quick thinking decide who survives. Outsmart your opponents, punish their mistakes, and master your next move in multiplayer PvP or sharpen your skills solo against bots.

apps.name: King of Billiards
apps.short_description: Take your place at the table. Aim with the mouse, feel every stroke, and play Chinese 8-ball, 9-ball, Snooker or Skill Duel. Jump over obstacles, change the table with skill cards, practise alone, or challenge AI and friends.

apps.name: Kiosco Simulator
apps.short_description: Kiosco Simulator is a management simulator where you run a 24-hour kiosco in the heart of the conurbano bonaerense. Your goal is to serve customers, manage stock, survive the night, and build up your reputation, all while trying to earn enough money to upgrade your store and expand your business.

apps.name: LAST SLIME
apps.short_description: When and where will you leave each slime behind? Guide a linked caravan of slimes, detach them to make paths, hold switches, and block hazards, then collect every LOVE on the board. Plan around each slime's color and your caravan's order in this turn-based grid puzzle.

apps.name: Legend Dary
apps.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

apps.name: LOOPLINE
apps.short_description: A top-down survivors-like where your ship's neon trail is your only attack. Circle a swarm, close the loop, and everything inside bursts at once. Bigger loops hit harder but keep you exposed for longer. A run takes about ten minutes.

apps.name: Lots of Axos
apps.short_description: Axolotls are nearly extinct. Your lab is their last hope. Build tanks, hatch axolotls, discover endless variations and help introduce them to new habitats across the globe

apps.name: LOTTERY
apps.short_description:
The only game in the world to bring the joy of tactical FPS games into the single-player experience.
Fight the entire world with superpowers gifted to you by sheer luck as you wipe out thousands of the world's most elite defenses while they try predicting, learning, and adapting to your every move.

apps.name: lucky me
apps.short_description: A live-action interactive romance. Lin Yu joins a travel dating show as its only male contestant after failing his exams. Meet four women in first person, shape relationships through dates and choices, and discover multiple endings. Is the love on camera real?

apps.name: Magi Scapes
apps.short_description: A pixel-art sandbox with deeply customizable AI NPCs. Build, farm, explore, and fight together. Here, companionship is more than just conversation.

apps.name: Marco!
apps.short_description: Marco Polo, except the person who's it can see your noise. Hide as a Noisemaker or hunt as a blindfolded Noisechaser in this microphone-powered game of hide-and-seek. Every footstep, whisper, and laugh can give you away. Stay quiet, get your friends caught, and try not to be the one who laughs.

apps.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim
apps.short_description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

apps.name: Masked Up
apps.short_description:
Online Rogue-like Game.
Choose a various characters and masks to defeat your enemies.

apps.name: Mile High Club
apps.short_description: An adult pixel-art airline management sim. Serve the cabin with quick hands-on mini-games, dress up your crew, upgrade your plane and climb to 5,280 feet to join the Mile High Club.

apps.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
apps.short_description: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

apps.name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 3
apps.short_description: Dive into the latest installment of the “Battle Operation” series, the epic free-to-play team combat game set in the Mobile Suit Gundam multiverse. Enlist as a mercenary, pilot legendary mobile suits, and fight together to conquer the battlefield in Mobile Suit Gundam Battle Operation 3!

apps.name: Mossmingle
apps.short_description: Mossmingle is a cozy 2D pixel-art gardening game where you plant and harvest flowers, earn coins, unlock new regions, discover wildlife, and grow your little world. Complete orders, upgrade your garden, and explore nine beautiful regions at your own pace.

apps.name: MOTHERLODE
apps.short_description: Dig into a persistent world of prospecting, mining and industrial engineering. Discover finite deposits, excavate real material, process it through machines, build power, water and logistics networks, sell your haul, upgrade your operation, and expand your claims alone or with friends.

apps.name: Mulligan Mayhem
apps.short_description: Golf, but the course is cursed. Tee off in peace, then fight the undead horde that wakes the moment your ball lands. Launch zombies with your driver, bowl them into each other and knock them into water hazards, with up to 4 players in couch or online co-op.

apps.name: Multiplayer Animals
apps.short_description: A turn-based PVP strategy game. Eliminate all enemy animals before they eliminate yours. Fire bazookas, launch airstrikes, destroy (and construct) terrain, or knock your enemies off the map entirely with a well-placed swing of a baseball bat.

apps.name: Neko ga Kita: Here Comes the Cat
apps.short_description: Set out food and wait for visitors to your garden. Send them hearts, pet them gently, and make friends. Befriend 48 animals, from cats and birds to mysterious creatures, earn gold as thanks, buy new foods, and fill your picture book in this relaxing backyard game.

apps.name: Neo Kinetic
apps.short_description: Neo Kinetic is a fast-paced anti-gravity racer inspired by classics like Wipeout and F-Zero. Race across the world on over-the-top tracks, tearing through futuristic cities and megastructures at supersonic speeds.

apps.name: NISKALA: Survivors
apps.short_description: Survive 20 waves of ghosts from Indonesian folklore in this chaotic action roguelite. Choose from 40 characters, collect bizarre weapons and powerful items, shop at the Night Stall, and experiment with wild builds as the supernatural hordes close in.

apps.name: Nordrstein: Vikings Together
apps.short_description: Nordrstein: Vikings Together is a 1-4 player co-op Viking raiding game. Row to Saxon settlements, blow the war horn, plunder everything and sail home with your loot to upgrade your village and buy new weapons and runes.

apps.name: Novella Oscura Reverie
apps.short_description: Novella Oscura Reverie is a dark fantasy JRPG set in the ruined kingdom of Albion and the mysterious Dreaming Realms of humanity. Explore a dying world, uncover its darkest secrets, and face enemies in a unique combat system that seamlessly blends real-time action with turn-based strategy.

apps.name: O2GETHER
apps.short_description: O2GETHER is a co-op survival game with one shared oxygen tank. Untether from it to scout, grab loot, or save a friend, but your air is on a countdown. Drift back in time, or black out. Haul the tank through wreckage, dodge the chaos, and reach the space station before air runs out.

apps.name: ODDSTABLE
apps.short_description: Read six-horse fields, lock fixed odds, and survive a twelve-race tour in a single-player offline horse-racing roguelite. Build tickets with virtual coins, take underground contracts, and turn charms into a payout engine. No real-money gambling or in-game purchases.

apps.name: PegLotto!
apps.short_description: PegLotto! is a roguelike that combines slots, pachinko, and deck-building. Pick your items, place them on the board, and pray that luck is on your side! Sit back, enjoy the view from the train window, and ride the waves of fortune!

apps.name: Pitstop Panic
apps.short_description: Pitstop Panic is a co-op pit crew game where teamwork breaks down under pressure. Work together to repair, refuel, and get the car back on track, but mistakes, distractions, and poor timing quickly turn simple pit stops into chaos.

apps.name: Pixireels
apps.short_description: Pixireels is a cozy pixel-art slot roguelike where you stack rule-breaking coins, chain runaway multipliers, watch a tiny score get out of hand through runs, and squeeze thirty rounds per run to unlock who knows what. Then you spend it all on a cat who does not appreciate it. Good luck!

apps.name: PJカオス
apps.short_description:
ハンドフォークを使って荷物を運び、トラックに載せるゲーム

道中には様々な障害物があり、ぶつかるとゲームオーバー

荷物は永遠に登場するためゲームオーバーにならないように運び続けて最高得点を目指せ

apps.name: Poor Samantha: An Agoraphobic Visual Novel
apps.short_description: "Noodles are the food of solitude." Trapped by agoraphobia and social anxiety, your only friend is Samantha. She is your courage to open the door. But in a room of broken mirrors, who is actually speaking? A short psychological visual novel about isolation and the lies we tell ourselves.

apps.name: Prison Fury
apps.short_description:
One of the most complex and difficult co-op games on Steam, where you and a friend play as ex-convicted cats trapped in a hellish prison.

Must work together to escape before time's up.

apps.name: Pro Sports Boxing
apps.short_description: It's fight time! Pro Sports Boxing brings the speed, the power and bone crunching action into the palm of your hands! A boxing game made for true boxing fans, simulating an authentic boxing experience.

apps.name: Probably Nothing
apps.short_description: Wake on a floating island and find the way home with your friends. Gather, craft and build on Haven, hunt across islands linked by magic teleporters, help Jamie run his farm, and unwind at the festival square and The Beast coaster.

apps.name: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator
apps.short_description: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator is a 2.5D first-person adventure mystery game where you play as an investigator who solves cases by taking pictures of cryptids, urban legends, & mythological creatures as well as befriending them in an open-world environment

apps.name: Project Leyline
apps.short_description: Project Leyline is a warfare fantasy-shooter where magic, steel, and dragons clash in a massive battlefield.

apps.name: Protect Pine Valley
apps.short_description: Defend Pine Valley against invading enemy armies! Switch between tactical command and third-person combat as you lead your troops through dynamic battles, changing terrain, and fierce weather.

apps.name: Pucked Up
apps.short_description: The oddball hockey deckbuilder. Construct your roster, customize your playbook, and survive a season against teams that will do anything to cheat their way to victory. Outsmart your competition, make the playoffs, and hoist the cup in a league where every run is unique.

apps.name: Puddle Makers
apps.short_description: Be a fish. Make a bigger puddle. Dig, loot, and bring down buildings in this physics sandbox for 1–4 players. Sell your finds, upgrade your fish, and turn the neighborhood into your swimming pool. Bring friends. The seagulls brought an appetite.

apps.name: Pursuit of Life
apps.short_description: Live your dream life in a sunny pixel beach city—start in your parents’ spare room, work jobs, master skills, launch businesses, and forge friendships, romance, or rivalries in a cozy sandbox where every choice shapes your future.

apps.name: Qwak
apps.short_description: Cute looks. Brutal gameplay. Qwak Reborn is a frantic arcade platformer packed with action, power-ups, secrets, puzzles and traps. Simple to learn. Impossible to put down. Even better with a friend!

apps.name: Radical Zomboarding
apps.short_description: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

apps.name: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up
apps.short_description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

apps.name: Riding Shotgun
apps.short_description: Just you, the road, and 40,000 demons. Drive and shoot your way through an endless hoard of satanic spawns in this adrenaline fueled road trip from Hell. keep your wits about you to reach your destination; the City of Sin - Las Vegas.

apps.name: Road 66
apps.short_description: ROUTE 66 SIMULATOR is a car building, fixing, and driving survival adventure. Earn money for food, gas, car parts, motels, and everything that will allow you to survive in the long journey.

apps.name: Robinson: Survival
apps.short_description: A turn-based card strategy game about survival and exploring an unknown land. Build your deck, embark on expeditions, gather resources, craft tools, and establish a camp. Help Miss Robinson survive, uncover the truth about her past, and choose the path her future will take.

apps.name: Ruins of The Titan
apps.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

apps.name: SAGWI
apps.short_description: SAGWI is a dark fantasy action roguelite inspired by Korean folklore. Battle hordes of terrifying spirits and mythical beasts, master powerful skills, and face deadly bosses. Upgrade your equipment, discover unique builds, and survive the darkness.

apps.name: Save the Forest
apps.short_description: Save the Forest is a turn-based tactics roguelite where you lead a squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Combine unit upgrades with tight tactical positioning and some help from unexpected forest dwellers!

apps.name: Save the Sandcastle
apps.short_description: The tide is coming. Dig for sand, build defences and guide the water across 36 beach puzzles. Keep your sandcastle standing, manage your stamina and improve your construction through further tides in Endless.

apps.name: Sea Days
apps.short_description: Sail an ocean-going cruising sailboat through real currents and tides. Every new port you reach unlocks the routes around it. Resupply, rest, then push on to a farther coast. Take the helm yourself or hand it to the autopilot. Ocean passages take days. Close the game and the voyage continues.

apps.name: Sea to Land
apps.short_description: Turn a sunny bay into land, one stone at a time. Gather stone, build paths between eight islands, and grow a coastal town. Work in first person or switch to a real-time overview to direct up to three construction crews.

apps.name: Seal The Deal
apps.short_description: Work the harbor night shift with friends in a co-op crime sim. Inspect cargo, steal valuables, print counterfeits and trade on the black market. Deal with gangs, fight off rivals and hide stolen goods before the police arrive. Honest work is optional.

apps.name: Shardbreakers
apps.short_description: Start with a spell. Build a storm. Combine magical shards into a spell engine that turns one hit into a barrage, then unleash it on hordes and bosses. An action roguelite where you don't find combos - you design them.

apps.name: Sheep Tag 2
apps.short_description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

apps.name: Ship Busters
apps.short_description: Sink ships the hard way, one plank at a time. Arc your shot, tear the sails, set the deck alight, then charge every gun on the flank and fire them as one. Free to play.

apps.name: Singulost
apps.short_description: Singulost is an exploratory interplanetary adventure. Explore forgotten worlds, pilot a spaceship, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of the most ancient civilization that was here before you.

apps.name: SkyLeague
apps.short_description:
Master an acrobatic Skycar in competitive car-soccer. Build speed, control the
air, outplay rivals with advanced mechanics, and shape a machine that is
unmistakably yours.

apps.name: SlashZero
apps.short_description:
SlashZero is a side-scrolling action roguelike game. 
As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! 
Is what you see the truth?

apps.name: Smash Their Heads
apps.short_description: Smash mechanical heads in a twisted circus! A short active incremental game. Cash in poker chips, upgrade your launcher, and keep the crowd entertained before they get bored!

apps.name: Soul Pact
apps.short_description: A cooperative puzzle adventure where players take on the roles of a wizard's body and soul, working together to solve challenging puzzles set by a Fallen Angel in a dark, mysterious castle.

apps.name: Soul Tides
apps.short_description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

apps.name: StandOff
apps.short_description: StandOff is a dark fantasy dungeon RPG. Lead a company through shifting rooms, fight, scavenge and equip your companions. Carry light into the depths, hold your ground against enemy waves, and risk your crew for loot and lasting upgrades.

apps.name: StoneHold MOBA
apps.short_description: StoneHold is a free-to-play 5v5 action MOBA where collectible card strategy meets intense third-person combat. Pick a Warden, build a deck, draw by crushing turrets and defeating enemies, then swap cards and skills at base for constant counterplay. UE5 visuals and a world of chiseled stone magic.

apps.name: Strato Alto
apps.short_description:
Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. 
Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory!
Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

apps.name: Studio Sim
apps.short_description: Build a film and television empire in a living entertainment industry beginning in the 1980s. Create and manage productions, cast unique talent, outmaneuver rival studios, climb the box office and grab television ratings in this immersive, old-school tycoon sim.

apps.name: Super Hamster Havoc
apps.short_description: Super Hamster Havoc is a fast-paced, multiplayer twin-stick shooter where hamsters and rats go head-to-head in an all-out war!

apps.name: SWARM GATE
apps.short_description: Hold the gate against ground and airborne swarms in a dark-fantasy defence shooter. Upgrade your arsenal, defeat powerful lords, then take direct control of unlocked heroes—turn, hover and strike back through a 30-day campaign and endless defence.

apps.name: Swatch Spill
apps.short_description: A wall of hooks, a floor of spilled paint cards, and a few hundred colours that all look like the same colour until you look properly. Sort them back. Take your time, or put yourself on the clock.

apps.name: swing droid.
apps.short_description: a one-button game about a little droid on a rope: press to grab the nearest anchor, press again to let go, and swing to the exit as fast as you can without touching the walls. easy to finish a level, hard to get gold, with instant retry, ghosts, medals and leaderboards.

apps.name: Swords and Hexes
apps.short_description: "Swords & Hexes" is a hex-and-slash RPG adventure! Where a scruffy serf and his freaky dog try to resist the hero's journey in a hex-obsessed world, be it by their own might, or perchance magic.

apps.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
apps.short_description: A 3D tactics RPG set in a fantasy retelling of  the Imjin War of 1592 in Korea. Command your squad across height-based grids where elemental matchups and terrain turn the tide. Branch through a three-tier class tree and forge deep equipment builds to make every unit your own.

apps.name: Temple Of Your Mom
apps.short_description: A puzzle RPG with turn-based combat and a darkly silly story. Estimated playtime is 4-6 hours.

apps.name: The Archivist
apps.short_description: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

apps.name: The Compliant
apps.short_description: A dark workplace parable in visual-novel form. As Lin Zhi works at Sabo Group, he uncovers buried secrets—AI, human experimentation, thought control—while clues keep surfacing. What will you choose? The game features 13 distinct characters and 15 endings to unlock.

apps.name: The Hambagu Shop
apps.short_description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

apps.name: The Last Interview: Into the Furnace
apps.short_description: Read the case files, interrogate the robots, and decide their fate: back to society, or into the furnace. Your verdicts genuinely shape how the city develops — and watch out for the robots who refuse to jump.

apps.name: The Maiz
apps.short_description: Lost in a living forest maze, armed with little more than a pistol. Hunt for the lost wanderer through ever-shifting paths. Fight off hostile wanderers, gather gems and keys, and unlock ancient doors. Every maze is new, and every run is a fresh path through the trees.

apps.name: The Mimics
apps.short_description: A magical PvP Prop Hunt where focus and your voice rule! Morph into any object, hide, and tease via 3D mic. A Hunter's mistake means a 5-second freeze. Outsmart everyone!

apps.name: The Resistance: Behind Enemy Lines
apps.short_description: Build and defend a resistance base in wartime China. Organize production, recruit troops, plan your defenses and fight alongside your squad. Combine real-time strategy with top-down combat across villages, wetlands and mountain passes behind enemy lines.

apps.name: The Welcome Inn
apps.short_description: Run a cozy medieval tavern and build it from the ground up. Cook warm meals, serve ale to thirsty travelers, expand your inn, and watch your humble tavern grow into a bustling medieval inn!

apps.name: The Widow's Shadow
apps.short_description: Following her husband's death, a widow haunted by her town's whispers enters a twisted reality where she must confront the shadows of her past. A psychological horror visual novel inspired by German Expressionist cinema, featuring three different endings.

apps.name: Time Takers
apps.short_description: Time Takers is a free-to-play team survival shooter where four squads of three fight to become the last team standing. Choose a Traveler, fight for Time, shape your build by choosing Upgrades, and adapt with your squad as every match unfolds.

apps.name: Titanhelm
apps.short_description: Titanhelm is a co-op base building game where you and your friends build a settlement, command a Titan and fight back the creatures of a dark and hostile forest. Gather resources, harvest Soul energy from fallen enemies and upgrade your Titan before the forest consumes you.

apps.name: To Type a Tale
apps.short_description: To Type a Tale is a fantasy choose-your-own-adventure story where the only method of interaction is typing. Story progress, choices, and menus are all achieved through typing highlighted words.

apps.name: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles
apps.short_description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle game for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Turn your own images into puzzles, assemble them together in real time, discover community creations, and share yours through the Steam Workshop.

apps.name: Topsoil Town
apps.short_description: Face off against friends to see who can live the coziest life! Farm, fish, mine, cook, and craft your way to the highest score in this turn-based life-sim party game for up to 4 players.

apps.name: TOWAI
apps.short_description: Day and night flip the rules of strength! TOWAI is a fast-paced shedding card game where you adapt to shifting states to empty your hand first. Play "TOWAI" cards to invert day and night, turning bad hands into winning combos! Supports solo CPU and up to 6 players online with room code sharing.
developers: 株式会社 アマテル
publishers: 株式会社 アマテル

apps.name: Tower Power: Wall Fall
apps.short_description: Build your tower, reinforce its walls, and reduce your rival's to rubble in a turn-based fantasy card strategy. Master three resources, five distinct decks, and three paths to victory.

apps.name: Toxismash
apps.short_description: You’re innocent. The bubbles are toxic. Punch them where you want them, bounce them off everything, and parry, teleport, snipe or towel storm your way out of prison. A pixel-art arena brawler for solo, couch co-op and versus.

apps.name: Traumtal
apps.short_description: The monster in your head is on your side. A first-person psychological horror about the Cold War orphanage you were forced to forget, and the choices you made there. When you’re cornered, the monster offers to take over. Say yes, and you’ll survive. You won’t even feel bad about it.

apps.name: Triads
apps.short_description: TRIADS is a sci-fi turn-based tactical combat game where you command cybernetically linked mechs across hex-based battlefields. Maneuver for position, manage initiative, exploit firing arcs and rear attacks, combine fire against key targets, and avoid dangerous Cybernetic Feedback.

apps.name: Trionfi
apps.short_description: A card game with the earliest tarot deck. Milan, 1445. Play trionfi — the game the tarot deck was made for — with the Cary-Yale Visconti cards, rules rebuilt from historical sources and a museum of every card, face and object at the table.

apps.name: Two Robots: Unleashed
apps.short_description: The first competitive card game where players can create their own cards. Build your robot, craft your deck, and brawl in 1v1 arenas in the sci-fi world of Rennova. Climb the ranks, earn your place among the elite, and design cards that change the game forever.

apps.name: UNCOUNTED
apps.short_description: Uncounted is a massive incremental tower defense. One sector, one wave: tens of thousands of hostiles simulated on the GPU. Place and aim every turret before the drop, then spend the run to unlock the next gun.

apps.name: Unknown Depths
apps.short_description: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.

apps.name: V!be Bunny
apps.short_description:
A Rhythm runner that turns ANY song into a level! Drop in an MP3, a folder, or a link and run!!
Jump, duck, spin through the crazy funk

apps.name: Vanguard Valiants
apps.short_description: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

apps.name: Voltcube
apps.short_description: Discover Voltcube, an infinite, uniquely generated block universe. Create machines, explore a multitude of biomes, and build to your heart's content. Survival or creative, every playthrough offers a unique journey.

apps.name: VoxPrinceps: The Political Game
apps.short_description: Read the question. Read the electorate. Choose your answer before time runs out. VoxPrinceps is a political narrative-decision game where every debate can swing state support and your opponent gets a chance to swing it back.

apps.name: VTOL VR Mod Loader
apps.short_description: A community-made mod loader for VTOL VR.

apps.name: Waste Force
apps.short_description: <Waste Force> is a post-apocalyptic PvE extraction shooter. Drive a garbage truck with your crew and survive oncoming mutants and scavengers. Repair the vehicle during chases and collect resources. Connect special trailers to complete your own vehicle. Cleanse the surface as part of Waste Force!

apps.name: WDR:弹窗保卫战
apps.short_description: Ultimate mini idle tower defense! Cute pixel heroes are waiting to join you in defending against data invasions – right inside your desktop popups. Use an extensive variety of tower combinations and your brilliant tactical setups to fend off the boredom of everyday life!

apps.name: Well Up
apps.short_description: You wake at the bottom of an old well with only a worn rope leading up. Reach hand over hand, swing to keep your balance and climb inch by inch. Wet rope, slick moss, frayed strands and thorns stand in your way, and one slip can drop you all the way down. Ready to see the sun again?

apps.name: Where are my keys?
apps.short_description: Lost your car keys at the beach? Or was it the woods? Grab a metal detector and a shovel, dig up junk and treasure, flog it to a shady Fence for upgrades and find those keys, with no rush, before a tsunami hits, or before the bear comes. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Where are the Fish?
apps.short_description: An exploration game about finding fish in the desert.

apps.name: WhoKilledKK
apps.short_description: This is a first-person horror adventure game where you enter the mansion of Kun Kun, the richest man in Aikun City. Everything inside has been eerily controlled. Kun Kun has set up a series of puzzles to stop intruders. Can you solve these puzzles and escape Kun Kun's mansion?

apps.name: Wish Upon A Llama
apps.short_description: Wish Upon A Llama is a cozy life sim RPG for animal lovers! As Llama Town's rancher, breed and raise adorable furry friends while rekindling a forgotten bond between the community and animals. Get to know the townsfolk, build lasting friendships, and perhaps discover romance. Adventure awaits!

apps.name: Wonderland Gacha House: Muster
apps.short_description: A casual bullet-hell roguelite with character collection and a progression system. Collect adorable Figurines, gear up through equipment Gacha, and use everyday items to battle powerful Bosses. No in-app purchases, duplicates, or fragment systems.

apps.name: Zone Shot
apps.short_description: Zone Shot is a new and original sports game with roguelite elements. Choose your team, draft, train, and trade players. Choose between weekly events to build up your HQ and deck. Be the coach, choose your cards, and manage player choices in game to earn your way to holding the championship!

apps.name: お仕事やめさせてください！
apps.short_description: Your boss won't let you quit. So this is a boss fight. Read their excuses, counter with strategy cards, and put the evidence on the table. Win back your resignation date, your paid leave, and 38 unpaid minutes. 2 protagonists, 34+ endings and 43 titles — how you quit follows you to your next job.

apps.name: どいなかでリバーシ
apps.short_description: A cozy and gentle Reversi game set deep in rural Japan. Enjoy matches and conversations with Japanese-style characters through Free Match, Story Mode, Tutorials, Puzzles, and Endgame Puzzles.

apps.name: ラビィアンブックス
apps.short_description: Open and arrange books to grow emotions in this puzzle game! Guide Lavi through books to discover feelings like "Tears of Joy," "Fighting Spirit," "Serenity," and "Delight." Combine books strategically, amplify emotions, and aim for the highest score!

apps.name: ヴァルキリーコネクト
京门之下
apps.short_description:
Corruption stains a prosperous age. New clerk Xie Ning hits a drowning murder and serial slayings in Luanyang. Ghost tales spread. Choose evidence or heart.
Under Capital Gates: Ancient crime interactive game. Outwit killers, meet unique women. Your choices shape all endings.

apps.name: 再来亿竿 One Last Cast
apps.short_description: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment

apps.name: 古剑奇谭网络版 海外版
和同開珎オンライン
apps.short_description: Wadoukaichin is a classic kanji puzzle: place one kanji in the center to complete four two-character words at once. 100 missions from easy to hard, plus Time Attack, a Daily Challenge, and 16-player online battles with three rule sets. Every word comes with its meaning, so you learn as you solve.

apps.name: 夜行录
apps.short_description: Chinese folk horror × idle turn-based. You don’t act—you build the roster. Lead mercenaries through ten eerie regions in Nightbound: recruit, assign skills, farm affix gear, then watch auto-battles unfold as combat logs. Gear sets the ceiling; formation decides the fight.

apps.name: 守护猫老板
apps.short_description: Guardian of Boss Neko is a 2D anime-style top-down survivor-like game that incorporates a gathering mechanic. You play as a maiden Guardian, guiding Boss Neko to gather Magic Crystals while beating up monsters (or getting beaten up by them).

apps.name: 心靈刺客 Mindpiercer
apps.short_description: A top-down stealth assassination game. Your contract comes with no photograph, only a description. Slip through a crowded estate, read the clues, and gaze at suspects to confirm your mark. Then pierce his mind and break him with six arts. Choose wrong, and the whole house wakes.

apps.name: 忌質物管理局　第七保管室
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Ishitsubutsu Management Bureau. Earn ¥10,000 an hour inspecting cursed objects. Compare each item with its inspection record, identify anomalies, and choose to Store, Incinerate, Seal, or Report it. A job-simulation horror game with a seven-day mystery. Japanese only.

apps.name: 怦怦：心动碎片
apps.short_description: Thump: Tiny Heart Flutters is a casual jigsaw puzzle game. Complete puzzles one after another to uncover the hidden feelings and secrets of the girls hidden in daily trivialities. Here it’s only you, a puzzle, and a girl who’s been waiting for you.

apps.name: 撕下你的伪装
apps.short_description: A modern suspense game. Follow Lin Mo, undercover in a nightclub to find her missing brother. She uncovers organ trafficking—and his lookalike runs the crime group. 4 romanceable leads, multiple endings.

apps.name: 明治東亰恋伽 トワヰライト・キス
apps.short_description: The sequel to "Meiji Tokyo Renka" (also known as "MEIKOI"), Meiji Tokyo Renka: Twilight Kiss (originally released in 2015), is now available on Steam!

apps.name: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
apps.short_description:
The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel.
Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

apps.name: 正统三国：乱世之弈
apps.short_description: Recruit Three Kingdoms heroes and build a five-unit team. Combine faction synergies, merge heroes, and use equipment and stratagems to prepare for automatic battles. Every shop visit and formation choice shapes your run through an ink-painted age of conflict.

apps.name: 污血远征
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical RPG of war, corruption, and impossible choices. Lead a mercenary squad into an Abyss-tainted front, recruit scarred companions, and survive brutal turn-based battles with weapons, terrain, and forbidden power. Victory may save your squad, or make you accept the slaughter.

apps.name: 泣魂
apps.short_description: 《泣魂》是一款视觉小说游戏。玩家在当中扮演主角并选择正确的路线，确保自己和朋友的安全，游戏有多种结局，由你的选择决定。

apps.name: 溪流渔场
apps.short_description: A pixel-art idle fishing game. Start with a hand net, upgrade your fishery, and explore unique waterways. Defeat bosses, collect fish for your aquarium, nurture the ecosystem, and set sail to hunt giant sea beasts.

apps.name: 灵台;RESONANCE
apps.short_description: A Chinese sci-fi mystery visual novel with romance and branching choices. Investigate a meditation headset, uncover decades-old recordings, choose whom to trust, and collect 24 teardown notes across character routes and eight endings.

apps.name: 电网大亨
apps.short_description: Build and run your own power grid in Power Grid Tycoon, a 3D construction and management sim. Place substations, wire three-phase circuits, supply cities and balance costs. Upgrade equipment, handle weather and faults, or experiment freely in sandbox mode.

apps.name: 终末收容所
apps.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite in a city overrun by urban legends. Beat an anomaly down, seal her into a card, and send her into your next fight. Cards, units and skills all cost sanity, dice settle every clash, and every run brings a new route. Bring back what you can before your mind gives out.

apps.name: 职场判官
apps.short_description: 这是一款模拟职场判官角色的企业点评游戏。你扮演刚入职的见习调查员，通过搜索企业名称或统一社会信用代码，深入查阅真实企业的基本信息与运营档案。游戏内置多维问卷系统，涵盖薪酬福利、工作氛围、晋升发展、管理文化、企业前景五大维度，你需要根据档案信息逐项做出客观评分。每次提交点评都会获得经验值奖励，累积经验可提升等级并解锁全新称号——从新手观察者一路晋升至点评传说。完成特定条件还能解锁成就徽章，向全球玩家展示你的调查实力。排行榜系统实时更新，你的每条点评和评论都会影响排名，与全世界的判官同台竞技，看谁才是真正的职场正义化身。

apps.name: 迷因残响-致漂流于碎片中的你
apps.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

apps.name: 面条小队
apps.short_description: Noodle Squad is a physics sandbox adventure for up to 8 players. Explore an unpredictable world as wobbly characters, customize your look, and let teamwork, quick thinking and wild ideas lead the way. From clever cooperation to clumsy chaos, share the laughs and make memories together.

apps.short_description: The official soundtrack for Nomad Drive recorded in-studio to accompany you on the open road!
